children: Overview
Switzerland life insurer's H1 net profit rose 8% yr/yr to CHF 649 mln
Profit from operations for H1 increased 8% yr/yr to CHF 967 mln
Company to cut about 600 jobs by end-2028, announces CHF 250 mln share buyback
Outlook
Swiss Life aims for fee result of over CHF 1 bln by 2027
Company targets return on equity of 17–19% under 'Swiss Life 2027' programme
Swiss Life plans cumulative cash remittance of CHF 3.6–3.8 bln for 2025–2027
Result Drivers
FEE BUSINESS GROWTH - Fee result rose 11% in local currency, driven by own and third-party products and services, asset management, and independent financial advisors
NETWORK BUSINESS TRANSFER - Gain from transfer of Swiss Life International network business contributed CHF 29 mln to fee result and profit from operations
HIGHER NET INVESTMENT INCOME - Net investment income grew to CHF 2.40 bln, supported by equities, infrastructure and lower FX hedging costs

The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and 5 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the life & health insurance peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Swiss Life Holding AG is CHF870.00, about 5.3% below its August 31 closing price of CHF919.00
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 17 three months ago
